trial.human_note: Passes 7/11 corrections and cut observe 32 to 1, but survival fell on 4 of 5 seeds (median -36%); it traded observe for back-and-forth turning. Gate promoted on one extra success.
lessons: Never call observe: the game is paused so it shows nothing new. Instead, turn to search for medikits or enemies.
When health is below 50, walk to the nearest visible medikit immediately; do not turn away or look around.
Aim at the nearest enemy before attacking, and fire only one shot (one hit kills). Never turn away from a visible enemy.
